purpose: Create one coherent, richly inhabited, dramatically beautiful multi-district future city rather than small campus, tube bundle or disconnected sculpture

starting_evidence.D3S9: 2 independently drawn author 2D concepts, both ART REJECT; zero GLB fabricated

required_master_outputs: One consistent common-XYZ plan showing actual M production, R research, L private living and two public room axes
A LONGITUDINAL urban section through making hall, visible research observation, public transfer and L garden/private threshold
A TRANSVERSE urban section explaining roof=floor two shared inhabited boundaries and large public VOID as an urban room not graphic hole
Two coherent opposite CITY exterior perspectives revealing the same real structural hierarchy and large architecturally occupied volume
At least 3 human-eye AUTHOR views derived from exactly these same plan+sections (not independent contradictory panels)
Explicit artist review: city-scale asymmetry, heroic inhabited negative space, reverse elevation depth, and convincing everyday human use

canonical_space_contract.geometry_units: conceptual, common XYZ only; not Minecraft blocks or certified meters
canonical_space_contract.maker: genuinely roofed large public production room and arrival; shared roof physically supports research
canonical_space_contract.research: inhabited observation room with broad view into active maker room and connected public route
canonical_space_contract.living: private entrance+room inside substantial neighborhood mass with semi-public garden, daylight apertures and shelter
canonical_space_contract.shared_boundaries: M true roof=R true supported floor AND R true roof/wall=L usable garden or privacy wall; ONE source each, not duplicate slabs
canonical_space_contract.public_rooms: Two nonparallel INTERNAL civic rooms of significant 3D volume with real floor, roof, side enclosure, entrances and vertical transfer; no roads/loft bridges posing as rooms
canonical_space_contract.city_formation: Large art-defining spaces must dictate the EXTERIOR shape; never add separate outer shell after interior model

visual_disqualifiers: primary silhouette reads as 3 isolated stones/monoliths
small punched hole in otherwise solid blocks
bunch of exposed multicolored tube lines
back view looks like same flat pasted facade with no urban depth
maker/research/living human eye reduced to generic symbolic icons
a void is only a line drawn on front facade
hard_stop_if_failed: No complex real GLB, no addition of model detail, no quantity-upscaling; record ART REJECT/HOLD with actual images and explicit causes
post_art_gate_only: One same-XYZ true GLB source, genuine saved and independently reloaded to 5+ human and front/reverse cameras
Actual M/R and R/L shared triangle evidence from independent auditor
Independent finite floor, full-width+body continuous sweep plus enclosed-solid detector and negative controls
Two public room axes and vertical transfer verified with actual geometry
Formal 331/993 and G0/S1/G1/G2/G3 in separate strict QA after art approval
